articles.headline: Tesla Continues to Falter and Lose Value: This Renowned Analyst Predicts 60% Returns Soon
articles.summary: Tesla shares fell 3.08% after the company unexpectedly cut its annual capital expenditure forecast by a fifth, despite reporting an adjusted EPS of $0.48 that beat the $0.4511 estimate. Revenue of $28.05B was flat year over year, while GAAP operating income dropped to $718M from $1.62B as R&D rose to $2.76B. Battery shortages limited deliveries to 486,532 vehicles. Wedbush Securities analyst Dan Ives maintains a Street-high target of $600.00, valuing Tesla as an AI and autonomous software monopoly with expanding FSD subscriptions and robotaxi deployment, whereas most of the Street remains cautious with 21 hold ratings and downward EPS revisions.
articles.summary_zh: 特斯拉在公布调整后每股收益为$0.48并超过$0.4511的预期之后，因意外将年度资本支出预测削减五分之一，导致股价下跌3.08%。 其营收为$28.05B，同比基本持平，由于研发费用增至$2.76B，GAAP营业利润从$1.62B降至$718M，电池短缺也将交付量限制在486,532辆。 Wedbush证券分析师Dan Ives维持了$600.00的华尔街最高目标价，将特斯拉视为人工智能与自动软件垄断企业，拥有不断增长的FSD订阅量和自动驾驶出租车部署；而华尔街大部分分析师持谨慎态度，共有21个持有评级并下调了每股收益预期。

articles.headline: America's Second-Biggest Bank Says the Stock Market Is in the Midst of a Multibillion-Dollar Stampede
articles.summary: Bank of America reported that its clients sold a record $14.8 billion worth of individual stocks in a single week in October while purchasing $2.8 billion in equity ETFs, coinciding with a 1.9% drop in the S&P 500. Institutional, retail, and hedge fund clients all engaged in selling across various sectors, driven by rising borrowing costs, heavy data-center spending commitments, and concerns over artificial intelligence returns. Meanwhile, separate EPFR Global fund-flow figures showed technology funds attracting $18.8 billion. Bank of America noted that heavy institutional tax-loss selling ahead of the October 31 fiscal year-end also contributed to the selling pressure.
articles.summary_zh: 美国银行报告称，在10月内的一周内，其客户抛售了创纪录的$14.8 billion的个股，同时买入了$2.8 billion的股票ETF，期间标普500指数下跌了1.9%。 受借贷成本上升、巨额数据中心开支承诺以及对人工智能回报的担忧驱动，机构、散户和对冲基金客户纷纷在各个板块进行抛售。 与此同时，EPFR Global的独立基金流向数据显示，科技基金吸引了$18.8 billion的资金流入。 美国银行指出，10月31日财年结束前机构的大规模税损抛售也加剧了抛售压力。

articles.headline: Norwegian downgraded, Skydance upgraded: Wall Street's top analyst calls
articles.summary: Wall Street research updates compiled by The Fly featured several notable rating changes. JPMorgan upgraded Skydance to Neutral from Underweight with a $9 price target, citing that its Warner acquisition creates a media company larger by revenue than Netflix and Disney excluding parks. Phillip Securities upgraded SpaceX to Buy from Sell with a $250 target as compute demand outpaces supply. Conversely, JPMorgan downgraded Norwegian Cruise Line to Underweight with an 11 dollar price target ahead of Q3 results, seeing downside risk to second-half 2027 net yield estimates, while Piper Sandler downgraded Deckers Outdoor to Underweight following a sales miss.
articles.summary_zh: 由The Fly汇编的华尔街研究报告包含了多项重要的评级调整。 摩根大通将Skydance从减持上调至中性，目标价为$9，理由是其对华纳的收购创造了一家营收超过除主题公园外的奈飞和迪士尼的传媒公司。 辉立证券将SpaceX从卖出上调至买入，目标价为$250，原因是计算需求超过了供应。 相反，摩根大通在第三季度财报发布前将挪威邮轮下调至减持，目标价为$11，认为2027年下半年净收益率预测存在下行风险；同时，派杰投资在销售额不及预期后将Deckers Outdoor下调至减持。

articles.headline: AI Chips Today - Boosting AI Compute Efficiency Without Extra Power Consumption
articles.summary: Market discussions and updates highlighted various narratives across different stocks and sectors. A $78M stock was noted for controlling a $1.5B project with production starting in months. Zscaler management is betting that AI security transitions from an add-on to a platform, while other discussions touched upon quantum-era security transitions, General Dynamics submarine manufacturing, Michael Burry shorting Nvidia and buying a copper miner, and changing cybersecurity stock valuations amid artificial intelligence trends. Additionally, narratives for sovereign drone options, ammunition and drone companies, and Nasdaq were updated with respective fair value estimates.
articles.summary_zh: 市场讨论与更新凸显了针对不同股票和板块的多种叙事。 一只市值$78M的股票因控制着一个价值$1.5B且将在数月内投产的项目而受到关注。 Zscaler管理层押注人工智能安全将从附加功能转变为平台，其他讨论则涉及量子时代安全转型、通用动力公司的潜水艇制造、迈克尔·伯里做空英伟达并买入铜矿商，以及在人工智能趋势下不断变化的网络安全股估值。 此外，主权无人机选项、弹药与无人机公司以及纳斯达克的叙事也更新了各自的公允价值估计。

articles.headline: World shares are mixed after Wall Street's AI-related losses, while oil prices jump
articles.summary: U. S. stocks fell on Friday, with the S&P 500 dropping 0.2 per cent and the Dow Jones Industrial Average falling 541 points, or 1 per cent, pressured by surging oil prices and three out of every four stocks in the S&P 500 declining. Brent crude oil rose 2.4 per cent to $115.86 a barrel, its highest level since March. Gains in big tech stocks such as Micron Technology, Microsoft, and Nvidia helped cushion broader index losses. Meanwhile, the 10-year Treasury yield edged up to 4.99 per cent, and inflation concerns remained high as Wall Street anticipates upcoming Federal Reserve rate decisions and September PCE data expected at a 3.6 per cent rate.
articles.summary_zh: 受飙升的油价打击以及标普500指数中四分之三股票下跌的拖累，美国股市周五下跌，标普500指数下跌0.2%，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌541点或1%。 布伦特原油价格上涨2.4%，至每桶$115.86，创下3月以来的最高水平。 美光科技、微软和英伟达等大型科技股的上涨帮助缓解了更大范围的指数跌幅。 同时，10年期美国国债收益率微升至4.99%，通胀担忧依然居高不下，华尔街正密切期待美联储即将召开的利率会议以及预计达到3.6%增长率的9月PCE数据。

articles.headline: Nvidia Stock News (Oct 23, 2026): NVDA Falls 4.4% to $212.21
articles.summary: Nvidia shares fell 4.40% to close at $212.21 on October 22, 2026, amid a broader sell-off in chip stocks driven by worries over AI spending and the cost of capital following Meta's quarterly results. The decline left Nvidia 12.80% below its 52-week high, with volume 19.09% above average. The Nasdaq Composite fell 2.60% and the S&P 500 lost 1.21%. Other chipmakers also dropped, including AMD by 8.10% and Micron by 6.26%. Financial media tied the sell-off to market-wide concerns rather than an Nvidia-specific trigger. Meanwhile, CEO Jensen Huang recently outlined the DSX POD reference design in Berlin, while CFO Colette Kress warned that supply will remain a bottleneck through at least fiscal 2028.
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月22日，英伟达股价下跌4.40%至收盘价$212.21，跌幅比纳斯达克综合指数深1.80个百分点，成交量比平均水平高19.09%。 此次抛售受Meta季度财报后关于AI支出和资本成本担忧的重新抬头所驱动，并引发芯片股普遍下跌。 当日纳斯达克综合指数下跌2.60%，标普500指数下跌1.21%。 其他芯片制造商也大幅下挫，其中AMD下跌8.10%，美光科技下跌6.26%。 金融媒体指出此次下跌属于全市场抛售，并非英伟达自身特定因素引发。 此外，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋近期在柏林推出了DSX POD参考设计，而首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯则警告称，供应瓶颈将至少持续到2028财年。

articles.headline: SOXX, SOXL, SMH Plunge As Chip Stocks Sell Off Amid Supply Chain Concerns
articles.summary: Semiconductor stocks and exchange-traded funds plunged on Thursday after LAM Research CEO Tim Archer stated during an investor earnings call that supply chain constraints for certain components will continue to limit chipmakers and equipment companies in meeting end demand going into 2027. Nvidia shares fell over 4%, Micron Technology tumbled over 6%, and Advanced Micro Devices dropped more than 8%. Other prominent chipmakers such as Intel, Broadcom, Marvell Technology, and Qualcomm also closed lower. Related exchange-traded funds declined as well, with the iShares Semiconductor ETF falling nearly 7%, the Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X Shares plunging over 20%, and the VanEck Semiconductor ETF losing nearly 6%.
articles.summary_zh: 在泛林集团首席执行官蒂姆·阿切尔于投资者财报电话会议上表示某些零部件的供应链限制将继续限制芯片制造商和设备公司在2027年满足最终需求的能力后，半导体股票及相关交易所交易基金于周四大幅下挫。 英伟达股价下跌超过4%，美光科技暴跌超过6%，超威半导体下跌超过8%。 英特尔、博通、迈威尔科技和高通等其他知名芯片制造商也收低。 相关交易所交易基金同样下跌，其中iShares半导体ETF下跌近7%，Direxion每日三倍做多半导体ETF暴跌逾20%，VanEck半导体ETF下跌近6%。

articles.headline: 【テクニカル】日経平均株価テクニカル分析－200日線付近から強く切り返す
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: Nikkei Stock Average continued to decline amid selling pressure, dropping toward the 200-day moving average at 61465 yen as of October 23 before finding support and rebounding near the 62726 yen level seen on September 14. The 9-day RSI fell from 16.0% to 15.6%. A technical bounce is anticipated given the RSI levels, though initial selling may occur early next week with dip-buying expected around the 62000 yen mark. Short-term resistance is anticipated near the 5-day moving average of 63842 yen, the 10-day moving average of 65351 yen, and the 25-day moving average of 66281 yen.
articles.summary_zh: 日经平均株価受卖盘主导持续走低，截至10月23日向61465日元的200日移动平均线附近寻找支撑后反弹，并回升至9月14日62726日元左右的水准。 9日RSI从16.0%降至15.6%。 鉴于RSI的水平，市场预期未来将出现自律性反弹，虽然下周初可能因日内反弹出现先行卖盘，但在62000日元关口附近容易出现逢低买盘。 另一方面，短期上方阻力位预计在5日移动平均线63842日元、10日移动平均线65351日元以及25日移动平均线66281日元附近。

articles.headline: 決算のディスコ軟調・ブロンコB高値、イオンなど小売株に買い/日経平均続落【今日の注目株＆日本株市場見通し】「デイリーZAi」10月23日号（ダイヤモンド・ザイ）
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: The Nikkei Stock Average fell for a consecutive session, closing down 214.68 yen at 62693.16 yen, pressured by overnight tech stock declines in the United States where the Nasdaq tumbled 693.999 points amid heavy AI investment concerns. Tokyo market sentiment was also affected by Meta's 6.98% drop and Lam Research's sharp decline following earnings. Meanwhile, Disco reported an operating profit increase of 47.9% to 1166 billion yen for the April-September first half of the fiscal year ending March 2027, though its shares traded soft due to tech sector headwinds. Retailer Ion gained as funds shifted to domestic demand and the yen neared 156 against the dollar. Bronco Billy shares reached a record high after reporting a 48.4% rise in operating profit to 30 billion yen for the first nine months of the fiscal year ending December 2026.
articles.summary_zh: 受美国科技股隔夜大跌及纳斯达克综合指数因AI投资重度担忧暴跌693.999点的拖累，日经平均株価连续第二个交易日下跌，收盘下跌214.685日元至62693.16円。 东京市场情绪亦受到Meta下跌6.98%以及ラムリサーチ财报后大跌的影响。 与此同时，迪斯科公布截至2027年3月期的4至9月上半财年营业利润同比增长47.9%至1166億円，但受美股科技股下跌拖累股价表现疲软。 由于资金流向内需板块且日元兑美元一度逼近156，零售商永旺受到买盘青睐创下涨幅前列。 ブロンコビリー则公布截至2026年12月期的前九个月营业利润同比增长48.4%至30億円，创下上市以来新高。

articles.headline: 来週（10/26～30）の日経平均株価の予想レンジは、6万～6万5000円！ キオクシアやアドバンテストなどAI･半導体株の決算と、日米の金融政策の動向に注目！
articles.source: ダイヤモンド・オンライン
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: The Nikkei Stock Average dropped 2631.13 yen, or 4.03%, week-over-week to close at 62693.16 yen, weighed down by valuation and funding concerns over US AI investments that triggered position adjustments in semiconductor stocks. Mid-east tensions and higher oil prices also dampened investor sentiment, while capital flowed into US Treasuries, lowering the 10-year Treasury yield. For the upcoming week of October 26 to 30, the Nikkei is expected to range between 60000 and 65000 yen, with attention on the Federal Open Market Committee meeting, the Bank of Japan monetary policy meeting and Outlook Report, and major corporate earnings reports from Advantest, Kioxia, Microsoft, and Amazon. Among individual stocks, GMO Prime Strategy gained 69.56% following its RAG software announcement, Ondeck rose due to a new shareholder benefit program, and Ubiquitous AI gained popularity as a cybersecurity play, while Accelmark dropped due to a proposed share limit increase.
articles.summary_zh: 日经平均株価本周较上周末下跌2631.13日元（4.03%），收于62693.16円，主要受到美国AI投资的盈利性和资金筹措担忧引发半导体股票仓位调整的拖累。 中东局势紧张导致的油价上涨也冷却了投资者情绪，同时资金流向美国国债。 展望10月26日至30日的一周，日经平均株価预计波动区间在60000至65000日元之间，市场焦点集中在美联储公开市场委员会会议、日本央行货币政策会议及展望报告，以及Advantest、キオクシアホールディングス、微软和亚马逊等大型企业的财报。 在个股方面，GMOプライム・ストラテジー因发布RAG软件合作公告上涨69.56%，オンデック因新设股东优待制度而持续受追捧，ユビキタスAI作为网络安全概念股受到关注，而アクセルマーク则因提议增加发行股份总数而领跌。

articles.headline: 日経平均は大幅続落、アドバンテストが1銘柄で約293円分押し下げ
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 23日の東京株式市場で日経平均株価は大幅続落し、前引けは前日比1082.58円安の61825.26円となった。 前日の米国市場でメタ・プラットフォームズやテスラの決算を受けたAI関連投資の過剰懸念からナスダックが大幅安となり、半導体関連株を中心に売りが広がった。 対イラン攻撃再開に伴う原油先物上昇もインフレ警戒につながった。 個別ではアドバンテストが1銘柄で日経平均を約293円押し下げて値下がり寄与トップとなり、ソフトバンクグループや東京エレクトロンなどが続いた。 一方、ファーストリテイリングは1銘柄で約199円押し上げて値上がり寄与トップとなった。
articles.summary_zh: 23日东京股市日经平均指数大幅续跌，早盘收盘较前一日下跌1082.58点，报61825.26点。 受前一日美国市场Meta平台与特斯拉财报引发的AI相关投资过剩担忧影响，纳斯达克指数大幅下跌，以半导体板块为中心的抛售潮扩散。 针对伊朗攻击再开导致的原油期货上涨也加剧了对通胀重燃的警惕。 个股方面，爱德万测试以单只股票压低日经平均约293日元居跌幅贡献首位，软银集团与东京电子等紧随其后。 另一方面，迅销以单只股票拉升日经平均约199日元居涨幅贡献首位。

articles.headline: 東京エレクトロン(8035)の株価をどう評価する？AI需要と今後の利益成長を検証
articles.source: 日本投資機構株式会社
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 東京エレクトロンの株価はAI向け半導体投資への期待から上昇した後に高値から調整し、10月21日終値は10160円となった。 先端工程への投資や売上成長余地が追い風となる一方、研究開発費や償却費の増加も見込まれる。 27年3月期1Qは売上7324億円、営業利益2114億円で増収増益となり、塗布・現像装置やエッチング装置の需要が視野に入る。 一方で、顧客の設備投資延期や中国向け輸出制限などのリスクも存在し、10月30日の中間決算で上期予想の達成度や下期の利益率見通しが注目される。
articles.summary_zh: 东京电子的股价在因AI半导体投资预期而上涨后自高位进行调整，10月21日收盘价为10160日元。 尽管面向先端制程的投资与销售增长空间构成利好，但也预计将伴随研发费用和折旧费用的增加。 27年3月期第一季度实现营收7324亿日元、营业利润2114亿日元，实现营收双增，涂布显影设备及蚀刻设备的需求进入视野。 另一方面，也存在客户设备投资延期及面向中国出口限制等风险，10月30日的中期财报中上半财年预期达成度及下半财年利润率前景备受关注。

articles.headline: 視る日経！ニュースNEXT▼１日の経済・投資・マーケット情報を深掘り、明日に生かす！
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 「視る日経！ ニュースNEXT」は日本経済新聞や日経BP、英フィナンシャル・タイムズなどNIKKEIグループの総力を活用し、ビジネスパーソンや投資家向けに1時間の経済報道番組として配信する。 メインキャスターは八木ひとみ、コメンテーターは大塚節雄、キャスターはトラウデン直美と島田弘久が務める。 番組では時々の注目トピックを深掘りする特集コーナーのほか、「注目記事PickUp」やアクセスランキングを通じて日経電子版のニュースを振り返る。
articles.summary_zh: 《视！ 日经新闻 NEXT》汇聚日本经济新闻、日经BP、英国《金融时报》等NIKKEI集团的综合实力，面向商务人士与投资者播出时长1小时的经济新闻报道节目。 节目由八木ひとみ担任主锚定人，大塚節雄担任评论员，トラウデン直美和島田弘久担任主播。 节目除深入剖析阶段性关注话题的专题板块外，还通过“关注文章PickUp”以及访问排行榜回顾日经电子版的重点新闻。

articles.headline: Robinhood sees surge in bitcoin, gold prediction markets as traders move beyond sports
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Robinhood's head of futures and prediction markets, JB Mackenzie, stated that bitcoin, gold and oil price contracts are among the company's fastest-growing prediction market products. Speaking at the NEXTPredict conference in New York on Thursday, Mackenzie noted that price volatility contracts are starting to dominate the marketplace as traders move beyond sports and elections. The Federal Reserve's interest rate decision was Robinhood's largest event contract in September, while crypto contracts have moved toward settlement periods as short as 15 minutes. Mackenzie also mentioned that prediction markets serve to draw customers into Robinhood's other business segments, including equities, crypto, futures, options and retirement accounts.
articles.summary_zh: Robinhood期货与预测市场负责人JB Mackenzie表示，比特币、黄金和原油价格合约是该公司增长最快的预测市场产品之一。 Mackenzie周四在纽约举行的NEXTPredict会议上指出，随着交易员将目光超越体育和选举，价格波动合约开始在市场中占据主导地位。 美联储的利率决议是Robinhood在9月最大的事件合约，同时加密货币合约已向短至15分钟的结算周期演变。 Mackenzie还提到，预测市场正成为将客户引入Robinhood其他业务板块（包括股票、加密货币、期货、期权和退休账户）的途径。

articles.headline: Gold Price Forecast: Can XAU/USD Recover Above $4,000 as Fed Decision Looms?
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Gold prices entered a critical phase as XAU/USD briefly fell below the psychological US$4,000 level on Friday, 23 October 2026, extending a nearly 3% drop from Thursday. Spot gold dropped to approximately US$3,987 during Asian trading before recovering towards US$4,015. The selloff was driven by concerns over artificial intelligence investment valuations, elevated oil prices, persistent inflation risks and uncertainty surrounding the Federal Reserve's upcoming interest rate decision on 28 October 2026. Despite the benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield falling below 5% on 22 October, gold struggled to attract sustained buying interest as broader market deleveraging and inflation concerns outweighed traditional safe-haven demand.
articles.summary_zh: 随着XAU/USD在2026年10月23日周五短暂跌破4000美元的心理关口并延续周四近3%的跌幅，黄金价格进入了关键阶段。 现货黄金在亚洲交易时段一度跌至约3987美元，随后回升至4015美元附近。 此次抛售潮由人工智能投资估值担忧、油价高企、持续的通胀风险以及市场对美联储将在2026年10月28日做出下一次利率决定的不确定性所驱动。 尽管基准10年期美国国债收益率在10月22日跌破5%，但由于更广泛的市场去杠杆化和通货膨胀担忧压倒了传统的避险需求，黄金一直在艰难吸引持续的买盘兴趣。

articles.headline: Top Reasons Crypto Market Is Dropping Today
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: The crypto market dropped on Friday to a $2.82 trillion market cap, with the Fear & Greed Index slipping to Neutral (50). Bitcoin fell over 4% to trade near $81,500, while Ethereum and XRP faced pressure amid risk-off sentiment, tech selloffs, AI spending concerns, and spot Bitcoin ETF outflows. Japan's annual inflation accelerated to 2.1% in September 2026, boosting expectations for a Bank of Japan December rate hike. The Japanese yen strengthened toward 156 against the US dollar, and Brent crude surpassed $113 amid Middle East tensions. US 10-year Treasury yields climbed to around 4.98%, and gold briefly dropped below $4,000.
articles.summary_zh: 加密货币市场于周五下跌至$2.82 trillion市值，恐慌与贪婪指数跌至“中性”（50）。 比特币价格下跌超过4%，在周五交投于约81,500美元附近，同时以太坊和XRP在风险厌恶情绪、科技股抛售、人工智能支出担忧以及现货比特币ETF资金流出的背景下持续承压。 日本2026年9月的年通胀率加速至2.1%，推高了日本央行在12月加息的预期。 日元兑美元走强至156附近，受中东局势紧张影响，布伦特原油价格突破113。 美国10年期国债收益率攀升至4.98%左右，黄金价格短暂跌破4,000美元。

articles.headline: Peter Brandt's EUR/JPY Short Is His Firm's Largest Position as Yen Gains
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Trader Peter Brandt stated on X that a EUR/JPY short is his firm's largest futures and currency position, sitting at 175.65 in futures on his chart. The European Central Bank pays 2.5% on deposits compared to 1.25% at the Bank of Japan. On July 31, the US Treasury intervened by selling euros for yen alongside Japan, helping lift the yen to 157.57 per dollar from a 163.73 low. Japan's core inflation reached 2.1% in September, exceeding the BOJ's 2% target. Overnight swaps imply an 80% chance of a December BOJ hike, while the ECB lifted its deposit rate to 2.5% on September 10. Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama called an undervalued yen a problem, and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated Washington would join further intervention.
articles.summary_zh: 交易员彼得·布兰特在X上表示，欧元兑日元空头是他公司最大的期货和外汇头寸，在其图表上的期货价格为175.65。 欧洲央行的存款利率为2.5%，而日本央行为1.25%。 7月31日，美国财政部与日本一同干预市场卖出欧元买入日元，帮助日元从163.73的低位升至兑每美元157.57。 日本9月核心通胀率达到2.1%，超过日本央行2%的目标。 隔夜掉期显示日本央行在12月加息的可能性为80%，而欧洲央行于9月10日将存款利率上调至2.5%。 财务大臣片山皋月称日元被低估是个问题，财政部长斯科特·贝森特表示华盛顿将参与进一步干预。

articles.headline: Asian shares wobble as tech rout boosts bonds, dents rate hike bets
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Asian shares fell on Oct 23 due to concerns over artificial intelligence funding needs, sparking a major US Treasury rally and reducing Federal Reserve policy tightening expectations for 2027. Brent crude hit a five-month peak at US$114 a barrel amid Middle East tensions. MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares excluding Japan fell 0.3%, Japan's Nikkei dropped 1.3%, South Korea's KOSPI skidded 1.7%, and mainland Chinese blue chips lost 1.1%. On Wall Street, the Nasdaq slumped over 2%, with Meta and Tesla shares declining. The benchmark 10-year Treasury yield slid more than 19 basis points to 4.9591%, and the dollar fell 0.2% to 156.44 yen, while gold remained flat at US$4,021.99 an ounce.
articles.summary_zh: 亚洲股市于10月23日下跌，原因是市场担忧人工智能的巨额资金需求，引发了美国国债的大幅反弹，并削弱了对美联储2027年收紧政策的预期。 在中东局势紧张的背景下，布伦特原油触及US$114每桶的五个月高点。 MSCI除日本以外的亚太股市指数下跌0.3%，日本日经指数下跌1.3%，韩国综合股价指数下跌1.7%，中国内地蓝筹股指数下跌1.1%。 在华尔街，纳斯达克指数重挫逾2%，Meta和Tesla股价下跌。 基准10年期美债收益率下跌超过19个基点至4.9591%，美元兑日元下跌0.2%至156.44，而黄金价格持平于US$4,021.99每盎司。
